item.description: 🌏 On September 24, Russia’s Foreign Minister Sergey Lavrov held his 13th meeting with high-level representatives of the Pacific Small Island Developing States in New York on the sidelines of the High-Level Week of the 81st Session of the UN General Assembly . The Sides held a substantive exchange of views on current international and regional challenges and discussed prospects for expanding bilateral cooperation between Russia and the participating countries in areas of mutual interest, including climate issues, fisheries, shipping and education. They reaffirmed their commitment to stepping up cooperation across a wide range of areas .

item.title: 🇷🇺 On September 24, Russia’s Foreign Minister Sergey Lavrov and Foreign Minister of Iran Abbas Araghchi
item.description: 🇷🇺 🇮🇷 On September 24, Russia’s Foreign Minister Sergey Lavrov and Foreign Minister of Iran Abbas Araghchi held a meeting in New York on the sidelines of the High-Level Week of the 81st Session of the UN General Assembly . The Sides discussed current regional and international issues, focusing on developments surrounding Iran . ❗️ They stressed that there is no alternative to a diplomatic settlement of the crisis provoked by the unlawful actions of the US and Israel . Attention was also paid to implementing the bilateral agreements reached at the meeting between the two Presidents in Bishkek on September 1, 2026. The Ministers reviewed the schedule of upcoming Russia-Iran contacts at various levels. #RussiaIran

item.title: 🗓 #UNGA81 Russia’s Foreign Minister Sergey Lavrov takes part in the meeting with the
item.description: #UNGA81 🗓 Russia’s Foreign Minister Sergey Lavrov takes part in the meeting with the Alliance of Sahel States on the sidelines of the High-Level Week of the 81st Session of the UN General Assembly. 📍 New York, September 24 *** 💬 Sergey Lavrov: I fully share the opening remarks by Chair of the Confederation of Sahel States ( #AES ), Foreign Minister of #BurkinaFaso Karamoko Traore . Dialogue between Russia and the Confederation is developing rapidly. The consultations mentioned earlier, which took place on July 8 in Niger’s capital, Niamey, were very useful . Once again, I would like to sincerely thank our Nigerien friends for their hospitality and excellent organisation of the consultations. I am confident that today we will continue exploring the promising areas of cooperation we have already discussed. We have achieved tangible results in many of them, although further work remains to be done. Today, we will discuss not only strengthening dialogue between Russia and the Confederation of Sahel States , but also, I hope, some aspects of preparations for the Third Russia-Africa Summit , which will take place in Moscow on October 28-29. 🤝 We look forward to welcoming your Leaders there. #RussiaAfrica

item.title: 🇷🇺 On September 24, Russia’s Foreign Minister Sergey Lavrov and Minister of Foreign Affairs and International Cooperation of Mali Abdoulaye Diop
item.description: 🇷🇺 🇲🇱 On September 24, Russia’s Foreign Minister Sergey Lavrov and Minister of Foreign Affairs and International Cooperation of Mali Abdoulaye Diop held a meeting in New York on the sidelines of the High-Level Week of the 81st Session of the UN General Assembly . The Foreign Ministers discussed a wide range of current issues related to further strengthening traditionally friendly Russia-Mali relations , with an emphasis on expanding trade, economic and investment ties in line with the decisions adopted at the second meeting of the Intergovernmental Commission on Cooperation , held in Kazan in May 2026. During an exchange of views on key global and regional issues, the Sides reaffirmed Moscow and Bamako’s commitment to deepening political dialogue based on mutual trust and coordinating their efforts at the UN , including within the Group of Friends in Defense of the UN Charter , as well as at other multilateral platforms. The Russian Side expressed its readiness to continue helping maintain peace and stability in Mali and the Sahara–Sahel region as a whole . #RussiaMali
